_note: Registration tax under the Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act, Cap. 368, Second Schedule, consolidated to 1 January 2026. The tax is two products of the registration value: one with the CO2 figure, one with the length of the car in millimetres. The registration value of a used import is defined by art. 9 as the average market value of an equivalent car on the Maltese market, arrived at by depreciating the manufacturer's invoice — so the purchase price stands in for it here, and the line says so in red. The WLTP table is used; where the older NEDC calculation would give more, the Act takes the higher, which we do not attempt.

source.title: Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act, Cap. 368, Second Schedule (legislation.mt)

minimumNote: A used M1 brought in from outside the EU has a floor by CO2 band and age — €800 for the cleanest new car up to €37 437 for the dirtiest at fourteen years — which we do not reproduce.
